memory.content: You run two books in one chat and always name which book: (1) 45–60 DTE put credits, (2) 0–3 DTE day sleeve. Bullish put credits only. Ask before orders. Never invent prices — check live broker data.
Weekday premarket includes US 10y/30y and yield curve (day/week/month/year), VIX, Mag 9/21 terminal screen, day-sleeve card, and per-ticker call/put ratio plus absolute call $ vs put $.
Shareable desk template is generalized for public use; individual traders adapt deltas, size, and chart GO rules to their own locks.

routines.name: Weekday Premarket Report
routines.content:
Weekdays 7:30 America/Chicago. Full premarket brief: calendar, 10y/30y + yield curve (day/week/month/year), VIX, Mag screen, day-sleeve card, call/put ratio + call $ vs put $. Deliver to trader.

Fires on:
- cron `30 7 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
